panels.description: In-flight sequences vs the queue vs the --max-num-seqs cap. Waiting > 0 for sustained periods = you are hitting the concurrency wall.
panels.title: Admission: running vs waiting vs cap

panels.description: How long an admitted request waited before scheduling. Climbs when demand exceeds the seq cap.
panels.title: Queue time (p95 / p99)

panels.description: Fraction of the ~3.55M-token KV pool in use. Peak observed ~6.6%; the cap, not KV, is the throttle.
panels.title: KV cache used (headroom)

panels.description: End to end request latency measured in seconds.
panels.title: E2E Request Latency

panels.description: Number of tokens processed per second
panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: P50, P90, P95, and P99 TTFT latency in seconds.
panels.title: Time To First Token Latency

panels.description: Number of requests in RUNNING, WAITING, and SWAPPED state
panels.title: Scheduler State

panels.description: Percentage of used cache blocks by vLLM.
panels.title: Cache Utilization
Queue Time (avg)
panels.description: Average time a request waits in queue before scheduling.
KV-cache preemptions per second. Non-zero = KV undersized; requests are being recomputed.
panels.title: Preemptions

panels.description: Fraction of prompt-block lookups served from the prefix cache (--enable-prefix-caching).
panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate

panels.description: Number of finished requests by their finish reason: either an EOS token was generated or the max sequence length was reached.
panels.title: Finish Reason

panels.description: Fraction of drafted tokens accepted by the target model. Overall + per draft position (num_speculative_tokens=3).
panels.title: Spec-decode acceptance (MTP)

panels.description: Tokens emitted per target-model forward step (1 + accepted/drafts). Higher = more work per GPU pass.
panels.title: Effective decode speedup
